team.name: Sheilia Royal
team.title: Agency Principal / Licensed Agent
team.bio: With over 20 years in the insurance industry, Sheilia founded The Way Agency to bring honest, client-first coverage to families and businesses across Kentucky, Indiana, and Tennessee. She specializes in building customized commercial and personal insurance programs, and believes that meeting clients where they are — not behind a storefront counter — is the best way to earn their trust.
team.fun_fact: Sheilia named the agency after John 14:6 and has never missed a client's policy renewal in over two decades.

team.name: Audrey Lillpop
team.title: Licensed Agent
team.bio: Audrey brings 8 years of personal lines expertise to the Owensboro and Henderson communities. From first-time homebuyers to families looking for the right auto and umbrella coverage, she walks clients through every option so they feel confident in their protection — no insurance jargon, just straight answers.
team.fun_fact: Audrey is known around the office for remembering every client's pet's name — and she always asks how they're doing.

team.name: Kelly McCallister
team.title: Client Care Specialist
team.bio: Kelly has spent 10 years helping business owners across Owensboro, Henderson, and Evansville protect what they've built. She handles everything from general liability and commercial auto to bonds, builders risk, and cyber coverage — and she's especially passionate about making sure small businesses aren't overpaying or underinsured.
team.fun_fact: Kelly once helped a contractor get bonded, insured, and on a job site in under 48 hours — the client still talks about it.

team.name: Jill Boone
team.title: Licensed Agent
team.bio: Jill has 6 years of experience guiding individuals and families through life, health, and Medicare decisions in the Mt. Washington and Louisville area. Whether it's choosing the right Medicare plan during open enrollment or finding affordable group health coverage for a growing team, Jill makes the process feel simple and personal.
team.fun_fact: Jill volunteers every fall at local Medicare enrollment events and has helped over 300 seniors find the right plan.

team.name: Allison Sommers
team.title: College Intern
team.bio: Allison is a college intern learning the ropes of independent insurance from the ground up. She supports the team with client communications, research, and day-to-day office tasks — and she's already picking up on what makes great coverage advice.
team.fun_fact: Allison can explain the difference between an HO-3 and an HO-5 policy better than most people twice her age.
